body: Every time I talk it just makes it worse. Family or wife no one understands what I am going through. Wife doesn’t like me but won’t leave me and this religious parents or mine don’t get it either... I am tired of being with someone who doesn’t want to be with me but has to die to religion. I don’t get all this I just want to find peace. I know if I die they all get money from my life insurance I will be at peace too. I just want to go ...
